vrtti:
**DSV: **haśaṣachāntānāṃ yajādīnāṃ ca liṅgānām antasya virāme vyañjanādiṣu ca ḍo bhavati, madhuliṭ, madhuliḍbhyām, madhuliṭpāśaḥ, suviṭ, suviḍbhyām, suviṭtaraḥ, ṣaṭ, ṣaḍbhyām, ṣaḍbhyaḥ, ṣaṭtvam, śabdaprāṭ, śabdaprāḍbhyām, śabdaprāṭtvam, deveṭ, deveḍbhyām, deveṭtvam, rajjusṛṭ, rajjusṛḍbhyām, rajjusṛṭtvam.
yaj, sṛj, mṛj, rāj, bhrāj, vraśc, bhrasj, parivrāj, ete yajādayaḥ.
notes:
**险狮子注：**ha、śa、ṣa、cha结尾的和yaj等词基的尾音在virama和辅音等之前变成ḍa。例如madhuliṭ, madhuliḍbhyām(舔蜂蜜，指蜜蜂), madhuliṭpāśaḥ(一群蜜蜂), suviṭ, suviḍbhyām, suviṭtaraḥ(来的好), ṣaṭ, ṣaṭbhyām, ṣaṭbhyaḥ, ṣaṭtvam(六), śabdaprāṭ, śabdaprāḍbhyām, śabdaprāṭtvam(问字), deveṭ, deveḍbhyām, deveṭtvam(祭祀天神), rajjusṛṭ, rajjusṛḍbhyām, rajjusṛṭtvam(做绳子)。
yaj(祭祀), sṛj(放出), mṛj(洗), rāj(统治), bhrāj(闪耀), vraśc(倒), bhrasj(？), parivrāj(逛荡), 这些是yaj等词。
